en.content:
When generating facial consistency with Seedance 2.0 Mini, upload additional reference images and use techniques to enhance consistency.  
Use Seedance 2.0 Mini for quick drafts, and for final detailed edits, use the full version of Seedance.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] Seedance Mini
Compared to grok, its facial consistency is a weakness, requiring additional reference images and techniques to barely pass. In summary, Mini is suitable for quick drafts, but for final detailed edits, use the full version. https://t.co/Y9OXHkd4sQ

[Thread 2] This replaced the junior sister's face completely, and it doesn't look like her at all.
